decisions.reason: The marine cooling unit lost its complementary box cooler line and has not been visible since 2019, and the marine downturn suggests a likely shortfall against aspirations, but it builds on core marine competences and the growing firm's slack lets it be carried for another year under review.

The compact oil cooler line was only lightly visible and has not been observed since 2019, which raises doubts, but it sits close to established competences and carries low ongoing cost, so no problemistic search is yet triggered.
Finned tubes are a component feeding the core air cooler business, so their value is tied to established operations even though their recent visibility is unclear.
Enhanced tubes embody the firm's in-house R&D and efficiency strategy, which the sustainability demands of 2022 make more relevant, so the firm keeps them despite limited evidence of results.
